parts.text: Edit this image: the cursed skin-bound book (stitched leather cover, bone clasps, rusty chain, no title, no lettering, no face on the cover) is now tucked firmly UNDER his left arm, pressed against his side with the arm clamped over it, instead of held out in front. Keep everything else exactly the same: face, clothing, weapons, pose, background and the matte clay stop-motion style.

Edit this image: cover his open olive vest with many small colourful enamel collector pins and badges (our own simple designs: tiny skulls, knives, masks, stars, no lettering, no logos, no real characters), like a pin-trader vest. Keep everything else exactly the same: face, clothing, weapons, pose, background and the matte clay stop-motion style.
